mechanism: Armodafinil is metabolized by CYP3A4 and may induce hepatic metabolism, while pyrazinamide undergoes hepatic metabolism and can cause hepatotoxicity, increasing risk of altered armodafinil levels and liver injury.
action: Monitor liver function tests regularly; consider alternative to armodafinil if possible during pyrazinamide therapy; assess for armodafinil efficacy changes.
